name: Gerald Steere
biography: Gerald Steere has been a member of the C+E Red Team since joining Microsoft in June 2014. He regularly dives into the deepest corners of Azure looking for vulnerabilities unique to the cloud scale environment and collecting all the creds. Prior to that, he was a security auditor and penetration tester for three civilian Federal agencies, where he acquired a love for obtaining and cracking as many passwords as possible. He has spoken on cloud security topics at multiple BlueHat events and most recently at BSides Seattle. @darkpawh
